validationModes.unordered_exact: Multiset equality of RDF terms, preserving duplicates, datatypes, language tags and unbound variables. Blank nodes require isomorphism or INCONCLUSIVE; no blank nodes are expected in these projections.
validationModes.ordered_exact: Same RDF-term equality as unordered_exact, additionally requiring row sequence equality.

queries.name: LUBM selective student star
queries.description: Courses and contact information of GraduateStudent0 in Department 0.

queries.name: BSBM selective product feature star
queries.description: Products featuring ProductFeature2719 with labels, producers, and real reviews.
queries.notes: Feature2719 is observed on Product1 in the small local dataset; its frequency depends on generation parameters.

queries.name: BSBM products without cheap fast offers (MINUS)
queries.description: Products without offers under 100 USD delivered within three days (MINUS).
queries.notes: bsbm:price is typed as bsbm:USD: explicit conversion of its lexical form. Q03 and Q09 must produce identical multisets; ?product is the only shared variable.

queries.name: LUBM student-to-university chain
queries.description: Student → course ← teacher → department → university traversal, without inference.

queries.name: LUBM student-advisor-course triangle
queries.description: Students enrolled in a course taught by their own academic advisor.
queries.notes: The join is cyclic; the underlying RDF graph does not necessarily contain a directed cycle.

queries.name: BSBM product type transitive closure
queries.description: Strict transitive closure of product types in the BSBM taxonomy.
queries.notes: rdfs:subClassOf edges are present in the dataset dump, without ontology additions or inference.

queries.name: BSBM bidirectional taxonomy reachability
queries.description: Types reachable from ProductType1 traversing the hierarchy in both directions.
queries.notes: An edge traversed in both directions makes the start point reachable via a path of positive length; termination requires handling revisits.

queries.name: DBpedia incomplete person records
queries.description: Mandatory persons and names, with optional birth and death dates via nested OPTIONAL.
queries.notes: Uses persondata_en.nt from DBpedia 3.5.1. ?death remains unbound if ?birth is missing, even if death date exists.

queries.name: BSBM products without cheap fast offers (NOT EXISTS)
queries.description: Products without offers under 100 USD delivered within three days (NOT EXISTS).
queries.notes: bsbm:price is typed as bsbm:USD: explicit conversion of its lexical form. Q03 and Q09 must produce identical multisets; ?product is the only shared variable.

queries.name: Bowlogna teaching unit evaluation statistics
queries.description: Integer evaluation statistics per unit, with at least two distinct students.
queries.notes: Ratings are xsd:int. Integer aggregates prevent inter-engine floating-point rounding discrepancies.

queries.name: Bowlogna aggregate subquery joined to unit names
queries.description: Subquery counting evaluations per unit, joined to unit names in the outer block.
queries.notes: The subquery is evaluated independently; only ?unit and ?evaluationCount are projected to the outer block. Not a correlated subquery.

queries.name: Bowlogna typed temporal and string filters
queries.description: Bachelor enrollments in October between 2003 inclusive and 2006 exclusive, with first name filter.
queries.notes: Dump dates are xsd:string in YYYY-MM-DD format. Explicit UTC midnight addition before standard SPARQL cast, with no engine-specific extensions.

queries.name: BSBM offer price ordered page
queries.description: Second page of twenty lowest-priced offers, with deterministic tie-breaking.
queries.notes: bsbm:USD is converted to xsd:decimal. Offer and product IRIs resolve ties for equal prices; all projected variables appear in ORDER BY.

queries.name: LUBM join across distinct named graphs
queries.description: Student/course join across distinct named graphs partitioned from the same LUBM dataset.
queries.notes: Run prepare_dataset.py: people receives triples outside takesCourse/teacherOf; courses receives takesCourse/teacherOf. Ingest the resulting N-Quads file preserving contexts.

queries.name: Named graph cardinalities
queries.description: Triple and distinct subject counts within each named graph.
queries.notes: Same N-Quads file as Q14; empty default graph, no implicit union default graph mode.
